description: README.md lines 99-108 show a struct literal: `let req = JmapRequest { using: ..., method_calls: ..., created_ids: None };`. JmapRequest is #[non_exhaustive] AND the recently-added `extra` field (commit bae3a90) is private-construction-required from outside the crate. Trigger: any external user copy-pasting the README example into their code. Bad behavior: compile error "cannot construct \`JmapRequest\` with struct literal syntax due to inaccessible fields". Fix: rewrite the example to use `JmapRequest::new(using_vec, method_calls_vec, None)`. Note: the in-crate doctest at lib.rs line 16 passes because it only DESERIALIZES; the README example tries to CONSTRUCT, which is the external-caller path.
title: README.md JmapRequest example fails to compile outside crate
